Genuinely asking as someone who doesn't trade memes much, how is this a curation layer if the tier is bought?

To me this reads like a pay to play advertising platform rather than a "trusted curation layer" because you can buy the trust, unless I'm misunderstanding.

Gold and Diamond tiers can be acquired by burning a preset amount of $ANSEM.

So a team can still rug if they are well funded and the amount they can rug for might make that a positive ROI endeavor relative to the amount of $ANSEM required to burn.

You rightly callout Dexscreener for pay to play mechanics but that seemingly is a core mechanic of z500. You can burn more and move up the board.

The airdrop piece is tricky. Free tokens to thousands of degen wallets isn't necessarily a holder base it's future sellers.

Teams are paying to create their own sell side, and the burn routes back into $ANSEM. 

Feels like you're selecting hardest for teams who need attention most, but those aren't always the teams building the coolest/best stuff. They can just be the most motivated/well funded scammers. 

Is there recourse when a diamond tier team rugs?

I'll continue to talk about the Robinhood Chain ecosystem because I still view it as the most obvious high growth area in the market right now.

Obviously will see some negativity when things aren't up only every day, but volatility is part of high momentum growth.

The irony of the discounts we're seeing on some of the big names over the last several days is that a lot of the same people posting about how they were sidelined in the middle of last week but would look for a solid entry if they got one, are posting today about how they knew this would happen and the top is most likely in.

You can trust them - or take a step back and look at the data and be objective about the situation.

The data + the narrative are the main reasons I am so confident to bull post as much as I have this early.

It makes sense, and it will continue to make sense moving forward.

Whether or not you buy $CASHCAT, $HMM, $PONS, $STONKBROKER, $TENDIES etc. I still believe now is the time to continue to stack solid names and chill.

I've been around long enough I've dealt with plenty of noise on the timeline before early on in big plays, so this is nothing new.

Conviction remains the same.

We're still early. 🤔🐈
